comment: Walker Scenic Road (Yavapai County Route 57) is in neither the national dataset nor ADOT's layer; it is drawn from the OpenStreetMap ways of Walker Road between SR 69 and Walker.
MnDOT draws each route once per direction (ROUTE_ID ending -I and -D); only the increasing direction is kept.

KYTC does not record which routes are scenic byways and which are scenic highways, so its own lines are labelled scenic highways. The national dataset draws Pisgah Pike, Boone Creek and Shakertown Road in the wrong place; KYTC's lines replace them (Shakertown Road is the 2.4 miles of US 68 at the Pleasant Hill entrance).
